main.description: On the source host, for the destination of a move migratePrepare started: a part of the group nothing public serves whole. `meta` is what this host keeps of a space as its authority, as a space meta archive (atproto-space-meta): its policy, an fyi.opensocial.policy; each account's grant beside the policy, as com.atproto.memberspace.member/<did>; and its writers, `repo` the group's own repo in a space (as com.atproto.space.getRepo does), `blobs` the list of its files and `blob` one of them. Authorized by migratePrepare's token, for an hour.

errors.name: InvalidToken
errors.description: The token is not migratePrepare's for this group, or its hour is over.

errors.name: BlobNotFound
errors.description: The group has no file by that CID.
